acquisition method: All samples were analyzed on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos tribrid mass spectrometer using an SPS-MS3-based method
cleavage agent: proteolytically digested with Lys-C and trypsin
collision energy: a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 34... an NCE of 45%
enrichment method: Phosphopeptides were enriched using Fe-NTA spin columns
fractionation method: the unenriched flow-through was separated into 12 fractions using basic pH reversed-phase chromatography
fragmentation method: MS2 scans consisted of collision-induced dissociation

labeling: Each time point was labeled with a different TMT11-plex reagent
reduction reagent: Samples were then reduced with 5 mM TCEP
